== June 2017 partial and full-image chronology ==
The shared [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|official PDF]], cover dated text as of June 1, 2017, prints a partial on page 2. Full sources are first located in repository records dated 8 July 2018, 23 December 2022 and 19 February 2023; these are not established first publication days. Descending moves preserve histories and exact source identity. Current gameplay <code>4_93</code> follows image 4; existing <code>4_93e1</code> publication identity follows the 2018 image without an implementation claim. No new historical executable ID is invented. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== Uncovered original fields beneath the June 2017 cutout ==
The source cover directs placing the lower cutout in a sleeve with the original physical card. Its replacement begins at the power/ability band, below the original title, destiny and lore. The original [[:File:Dagobah-D-captainneeda-decipher-archive.gif]] supplies the still-uncovered destiny 1 and literal lore; later full PC faces are not the source of these inherited values. Existing lower-slip text, images, numbering, links and executable IDs are retained. The literal uncovered lore supports captain and leader under the character rules (Advanced Rulebook 2023, PDF pages 177–178). Force-Attuned is instead the printed sensitivity attribute (page 78). Default landspeed 1 is independently stated in the original Glossary (1998), PDF page 34, and Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF page 77. Cover/source: [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]], PDF page 2. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
